fields.label: Applied Suppliers
fields.description: Suppliers listed here use this standard. Suppliers not listed in any standard fall back to the default configuration in Buying Settings.

fields.label: Rating Schedule
fields.description: Leave blank to use the default frequency / window from Buying Settings.

fields.label: Rating Frequency
fields.description: How often suppliers on this standard are rated. Blank uses the default.

fields.label: Evaluation Period (Months)
fields.description: Data window in months. 0 uses the default.

fields.label: On-time Full Score Rate (%)
fields.description: On-time rate at or above this gets full score

fields.label: On-time Zero Score Rate (%)
fields.description: On-time rate at or below this gets zero score

fields.label: Delay Full Score Days
fields.description: Average delay days at or below this gets full score

fields.label: Delay Zero Score Days
fields.description: Average delay days at or above this gets zero score

fields.label: Delay Tolerance Ratio (%)
fields.description: Allowed delay per order line = promised lead time x this ratio before counting as delay for scoring

fields.label: Delay Tolerance Floor (Days)
fields.description: Minimum tolerance in days applied to short or zero lead time items

fields.label: Delay Tolerance Cap (Days)
fields.description: Maximum tolerance in days. 0 means no cap

fields.label: Lead Time Full Score Days
fields.description: Average actual lead time at or below this gets full score

fields.label: Lead Time Zero Score Days
fields.description: Average actual lead time at or above this gets zero score

fields.label: Return Full Score Rate (%)
fields.description: Return rate at or below this gets full score

fields.label: Return Zero Score Rate (%)
fields.description: Return rate at or above this gets zero score

fields.label: Grade C Minimum Score
fields.description: Scores below Grade C minimum are rated D
